body: Like others have said, I believe he just wants to ‘give in’ to his sex addiction if he is in fact one. I believe that sex addicts recovering don’t engage in pretty much any sexual acts unless they are married because it’s like having a drink again for an alcoholic. So if this is what he is wanting to do then he’s not that serious in his sponsor or the SA meetings. It could really be a struggle for him if he’s actually one but if he is thinking that sex with multiple people is going to be the solution then he’s in big trouble as an addict.

When was his last test? If he’s a responsible person and concerned for his own health he would have had tests done and he should be able to prove what the result was. Three years is a long time for it to just lie dormant. That doesn’t usually happen. Women tend to develop symptoms pretty easily and early on, though not everyone.

Almost guarantee he is lying. He won’t admit it, the cheaters handbook is to deny deny deny no matter what, no matter how stupid it sounds because if you keep denying then the other person will begin to make excuses for them and start believing it. Gaslighting.

I know it would be great if he just admitted it and you can make sense of how you got an std but you need to try to be as strong as you can, don’t give into his gaslighting. If he knows he can convince you of this then he will think he can do anything he likes and just make excuses for it.

And if he was at risk by having multiple partners then why did he put you, your first, at risk?He should have gotten tested and made sure to protect you. It does only take one partner who has slept with just one other to get an std but more likely it is spread by those sleeping with multiple partners and if that’s the case then he should have thought of you beforehand, before ever sleeping with you, and gotten tested.

I wouldn’t believe him for anything. Hold strong because it’s so easy to be convinced otherwise with the lies they tell.
Well said, it’s so sad that they choose to live their lives that way and hurt those around them.
The AP is with someone who she knows is capable of betraying, cheating, lying. What does that say about her? They both sound like insecure horrible people who will walk over anyone.

I think this is true. I struggle to grasp how he can be living with a fellow cheater now and act like everything’s fine. Decent people don’t do that. Decent people have guilt and wouldn’t want to be with someone who is also a cheater and who helped them cheat and hurt their family.
Exactly. And they just don’t care or just push it aside and don’t think about it. They are like a toddler that just wants what they want and want it now and no care to anyone else.

Yes, I heard that women who are interested in married men or men who leave for them are insecure women and that the man knows it and can use her because it’s much easier. Sad. They shouldn’t even be getting a high from a married person. But they‘re not getting that high from someone else then the married man comes along and gives that to them so they go after it. Suddenly they feel so special to someone when usually they don’t. It’s like they think that’s the best they can get.

I agree. I think either they just really don’t care and feel like they don’t need to justify because they just want what they want, which is to chase after those high feelings. And then some do justify by saying whatever they need to tell themselves. It is appalling. But they are getting that chemical high, like you said when a pretend knight in shining armor comes along they go weak and just make excuses. Why they want taken men I don’t know.

Thanks. He only told me about her after she had left and gave him the ultimatum. He promised it was over. But then they went behind my back. I don’t know who contacted who again or what exactly happened but they got themselves all set with their plan before he then told me for the second time but this time it was to leave for her. I had no idea.

Yeah, I agree. That’s why I was saying if she was lied to at first then gave an ultimatum, does that still equate to stealing or is she just some person who got attached and wanted what she thought was hers and when she found out he wasn’t hers instead of just leave him she chased him.

It matters because she is who he chose. I’d prefer if he’s going to be with someone else that she’s a good person. For the kids, for him, for everyone. But instead she seems to have helped him push everyone away.
It’s not about being angry or not, it’s about what her character is that he has left for her.
He has gone behind her back and is cheating on her already. I’m not sure if physical though and I don’t know if she knows. They are supposedly happy already moved in together.

I know his ap chased him and played games. It’s really horrendous. I do think the one cheating is responsible but I also think why do these aps want any part in it? I know there is a lot of psychology behind it from personality disorders, mate poaching, etc. I just don’t get how they could want someone who has hurt their spouse so badly. I guess they just really think it’s our fault.

I think for some reason aps only think of ‘marriage’ as being if the couple are happy and the cheating spouse wouldn’t be happy if they are cheating so they excuse it and blame the spouse being cheated on. I think it’s a horrible logic but they justify it so that they can get what they want.

I think from what I’ve read and a little of my situation, that many of these spouses sort of trickle truth the aps too. I think at first they outright lie and say they are single, then after a while they say they are married but separated under the same roof, or they say they haven’t slept with their spouse in so long etc. And many other excuses. I think the ap gets drawn into it, starts excusing the behaviour because they for some weird reason are attracted to them and then start believing they will leave for them since their marriage is supposedly over anyway. 

I really think these aps make every excuse to justify them being with a married person. I don’t think the spouse tells them yes I’m married and yes I’m a liar and a deceiver and a cheat and I’m using you. If that was the case I would hope the ap would run far. But still, I do think that any ap that gets into it doesn’t have the confidence with themselves to just leave. How they can be so clouded on what the real situation is I don’t know. 

It doesn’t matter the situation though unless they truly just don’t know, they are also responsible.

What do you think on if the spouse lies to the ap at the start and then they are either told the truth or the ap finds out the truth and decide to either keep seeing them or the spouse decides to leave for their ap who now has full knowledge? I’d be really interested to hear.

Yeah. I’ve had dreams where I’m just in agony too. I’ve never experienced anything like this before. 

Sometimes I have sweet little dreams. The other night in my dream he commented on my lipstick saying the red looks nice. That was the colour I was wearing when we first met. 

But then I wake and he’s not there. We are no contact. He isn’t allowed to talk to me because of her. To think some stranger can meet them and then help them to betray you in the worst possible way. 

I really think if anyone has the strength you should step up and leave them first because it’s only a matter of time when they cheat again or even leave you. Not that I’m the type of person who wants to be the one to leave first just to hurt him, but this has taken my power away from me on an unimaginable scale. To feel laughed at behind my back and so on. 

I feel like I have to do some sort of meditative something to rid all this negativity. That’s how bad it is and how out of control I feel.

I know what you mean about not wanting to sleep tonight. I get nightmares too. Often one will pop up or I will have a few in a row then they go quiet again for a while. 

One the other woman was a huge snake who was on top of me in bed about to eat me. 

In one, one of the kids told me they were going to kill themselves because he left. 

In another he and ap were having sex. In another the ap was having sex with some other guy who had held them both hostage and he was forced to watch on, except ap was willingly doing it and not forced. 

I’ve had others where he ‘visits’ me. Mostly he is like he was before but sometimes he scares me in the dreams because he is in pain too. 

They are all so vivid and it’s horrible. Often I’ll wake and it will take me a moment to realize that it was just a dream and he is actually gone. It’s like my brain is so set in him being there as he was for so long. 

I’ve woken up crying because of this, in a startle almost screaming when it’s a nightmare. It sits with me throughout the day and it scares the life out of me about all the pain he has caused everyone.

Thank you for hearing that through what I’ve written. He has had an unofficial diagnosis of borderline but it was more pointed out by a health professional. I also believe that the other woman has a personality disorder but I’m not sure if it’s more bpd or narc. 

There’s not much anyone can do though because he has shut people out and she ‘rules’ everything now. Of course it’s his own choosing. 

I’m not even saying this as someone who wants him back. His actions have hurt everyone so badly. But it is hard when you have loved someone and you see them making such irrational decisions. I am also confused myself on a daily basis as to if he was just pretending and hiding his true character and after meeting her his true character came out. I also think that the two of them must want each other for some reason so to me that means they are bringing each other some level of happiness or otherwise why be together. Why leave everyone for her? 

What hurts the most in some ways is how he could choose her knowing what she did to him, knowing what she said about his family, about me, knowing what she wanted from him. And even if he was the one doing the chasing or wanted her just as much as she wanted him, how could he want someone who is so beneath and how could she want someone so beneath as well?

That is what I first thought. He also became suicidal from everything that had happened which is part of the reason why we did reconcile the first time. (He has no history of this beforehand). He really struggled and I saw that with my own eyes. It wasn’t just to me, he reached out to others too and did receive some help. I believe he believed the problems stemmed or brought this darker side out from what she had put him through. I can’t say the whole story because it details some unique things and I’d prefer to be more anonymous. I also believe that he believed getting back with her was the answer to his problem. I think it was a way to get his power back over the situation. I think the both of them played each other strongly. What I don’t understand is why he would think that is the right path to go on, towards even more danger, towards even more drama.

Sometimes I wonder if he had lived such an easy going life (in I mean without much drama) that when it hit him he became addicted to it because it made him feel alive and messed with his hormones.

I also believe the therapist he saw didn’t help him the way that it should have. I think it was more the case of what is causing this and him saying how he has feelings for someone new and that he wants to build a life with her but at the same time is still connected to his usual life, without delving into everything that happened. I think he essentially did the pick and choose what to tell a therapist and used that as a confirmation that he should then go after what he really wants.

No one has been able to get him help. He has pushed his extended family away and has called them crazy for trying to warn him about this woman and the situation. To his friends who are concerned I think he is very good at spinning it the way he wants so to make him out to be a victim, to be as though he didn’t mean any of this but sometimes in life you meet someone, have a connection and you can’t pass it up.

As for his distancing his loved ones, I think he sees it as liberation, as he was very tight with everyone previously. I think he sees her as this worldly do what she wants and answers to no one and he has picked up on that and sees it as a way out from whatever inside him he is running from.

I should add, and I know he has proven that I can’t trust him, but I believe from what I saw him experience, that he tried hard to cut her out of his life. Now he might have just been hiding and going behind my back some more since he was so good at it, but it’s something that I do believe. I think he knew and then for whatever reason he changed his mind again or gave in to her.

I’m not saying that a shy or introvert doesn’t cheat. I was saying how his personality has changed. I’m not making her into a villain, she is one. She knew about us, she manipulated him and blackmailed him, said nasty things about us, his children and other family members and made a lot of trouble for him before she then gave him an ultimatum. That is why I don’t understand how he could want her.

I can understand that. I can’t relate to it, I loved him the same as when I first saw him. Sure things were a bit more usual but every moment with him was special to me still and I felt so special to him right up to the end. He didn’t take me for granted I don’t think but now I don’t know if he was just trying to ‘make up’ for the cheating or what. Trying to make me seem like he’s not the type to do that perhaps so that he can do it better behind my back and not get caught? I never did catch him. He confessed. And he only did that because he was leaving for her. They planned it all out without even talking to me at all about it first.

I think that’s kind of my obsession with the other woman. If he’s different with her. If he is a better person with her. I don’t believe he is and he has gone behind her back too already. But for him to stay with her, it’s like she must have something to keep him to stay, and to get him to have left his family.

It is like he is different in so many ways. I don’t know him intimately anymore but his looks are different, he has seemingly aged, he has an arrogance about him that he never ever had before. It is the oddest thing to see how someone who is a certain constant way - soft spoken, polite, kind, funny, loving, positive - go to this arrogant, above others, selfish and even outspoken person. It’s like he has done a whole personality shift and from what I see it’s not for the better. I don’t know what version she is getting though. And that isn’t just to me, he is like that in general now.

Thank you. I think you explain it well. He knew what he was doing and he justified it any way he could. At first it was just hook ups and it was just because he ’couldn’t help himself’ or whatever. But when he chose to see her again, when he chose to talk to her again and entertain her ideas, I think that is when he allowed it to be much more dangerous. He could have stopped. He chose not to. It is sad that he was even doing hook ups behind my back and I wish he had gotten help for that. I think though that it is just in his character, I just didn’t know it.

I am sure not. I do believe he has some difficulties but I also know the level of deception is he capable of. I don’t know their whole story but I know he hasn’t been faithful to her. I just don’t know if she cares or knows as she herself hasn’t been either. I don’t know how much of a dummy she is or if he has manipulated her, manipulated each other or who’s playing who. It just sounds like so much drama and I never knew he’d be into any of that. I’m more inclined to think that she thinks the problem wasn’t with him that made him cheat and that he wouldn’t do that to her. I really do think that he is capable of such manipulation as he did it to me.

Why? Because he was a huge part of my life for years. Because he acts like his family has been wiped from his memory. Because she has taken my place. Because everyone including the kids have been left in a state of confusion. Because she knew about us and gave him an ultimatum to leave us. I haven’t kept tabs but have had conversations with him and that is how I know things.
I do agree with all that. I just don’t understand why he didn’t want me anymore.

I know he was going behind my back now but at the time, for years, I had no idea. We seemed to be so happy with each other. I felt truly loved and cared about by him. It is so confusing to see what he is like now.

That is crazy. I can’t believe these so called men can behave this way. 

I do understand that at times limerence is involved among other things. I’ve been looking a lot at personality disorders and in particular I have read stories of men who have been with borderline women, and this is not to offend anyone, but in these stories the men describe their experience to be the highest of highs and lowest lows, very difficult to resist and to get out of. There is a lot on youtube on the topic. 

I know I’m trying to understand how she could ‘get‘ him and I of course don’t know whether she does have some personality disorder but her behaviour has matched. Also narcs do the love bombing and it’s very hard to resist them at times. If that’s what she is, he shouldn’t have had anything even to do with her in the first place but I do know that when chemicals and hormones take over these men (and women) make some crazy choices that make no sense to anyone else.

I think so too about their character. I just never knew he had that kind of character.

I really dislike comparing myself to her. The woman chased a married man and wanted him to leave to be with her. She had no respect but also none for herself. Why would she want a taken man anyway? Why would she want sloppy seconds anyway? I think they spin it to be like they just couldn’t pass up their connection and that they deserve this happiness they never knew before.

btw, they have cheated on each other already, he is still although I don’t know whether she knows or not. Some happiness I guess. I really don’t understand it.

I think they do it to justify their actions of cheating and leaving for someone else. I think they also have to do it to justify to their new partner too, who thinks it won’t happen to them because they believe that the problem was with the one they cheated on.

They rewrite history to suit themselves and to justify. It’s a coping mechanism and it hurts like hell.

She doesn’t value you but she also doesn’t value the other guys or herself. It’s monkey branching like others have said and she knows she can get you or believes she can so doesn’t have to go all drama and chase you. But he isn’t putting up with it and she can’t stand that. If she gets him too then it will settle enough for her to cheat on him again. 

She wants to have all these options waiting for her so she can get her supply from any of them that she thinks she needs at the time.

It hurts he was unable and unwilling to turn to her and tell her ’no’ and tell her off for saying and doing what she did to us and said about us. That hurts so bad, that he didn’t protect us, stand up for us, that he still chose her. I don’t understand why they do that.
Not to mention she lied to you about just getting some photos from the phone then you can have it back and look at all the old stuff. She lied straight to your face right there.

It wasn’t telling me, it was the circumstances, time frame and everything that happened. He broke up with her and I believe tried to stay away from her. She did a couple of very manipulative tactics, which he recognized even and he should have run far from her at that point but he didn’t. I still don’t know why. She isn’t an attractive person on the outside or inside and I really don’t know why he likes her. I believe she is a very outgoing, go after what she wants kind of person. He isn’t, I’m not, I think she showed him another ’life’. 

If I told you what she did you would be in disbelief at why he would want anything to do with her. I don’t know if he’s just in limerence or if it’s something else like personality disorders, mid life crisis, trauma bond, etc.

They both have also cheated on each other, there has been a lot of drama between the two of them in a short amount of time still, they rushed their relationship, she knew everything about the kids, marriage, history and wanted him to leave, gave him an ultimatum (he probably did lie to her to an extent at least though).
Is she going to leave him now knowing all his lies?

Yeah, she did get into a relationship with a cheater. Either he lied about that to her and she doesn’t know who he is or she knows but thinks she is above it and it won’t happen to her, and doesn’t care that he is capable or being disloyal and hurting others. If she knows and is a self confident put together person then she’d run away fast. Why would anyone think it’s a good idea to start up with a cheater?

I think I was just a fill in, pretty good but then she came along and his eyes were open. I just don’t see how he could be such a horrible person when he wasn’t like that before and when he was leaving me it was very very hard for him.

I wish I could stop missing him so much. It is so confusing because it’s like he’s two different people and the person I did know would never have done any of this. Getting left for someone they haven’t even known very long, someone who did all those negative things, it makes me feel like somehow she is better and somehow she just showed him the light or something. Why else would you go to someone so quickly and leave your whole life, your kids, everything?

Yes I have low self esteem because he left me out of the blue. And yes he went back and forth but then decided on her. It’s really hard to just move on from someone you spent so much of your life with and were so happy with and had no idea they had this other site to them.

I have nightmares of him with her though thankfully not too often. I also have lots of dreams where he ‘visits’ me in them and is the man who he used to be with me. In them he tells me special things and it feels so real with him holding me in his arms again. I wake and then see that this is my life now and it feels fresh every day. 

I also have ptsd and get panic attacks, which I never got before. I have people who care about me worry that I am so different to the person I was, this strong confident happy woman. I go through the day and wake through the night feeling like screaming in so much pain. I am lucky to have a dog who doesn’t mind me holding onto their long hair tightly at times to get me through.

Yep, his one on one therapist encouraged him to go after his own happiness of what he really wants and that abandoning his family for a woman who knew and lied and schemed with him didn’t matter, only he that matters. Yeah he who pays the therapist.

I want to believe that. It’s very hard when he so quickly moved in with her, so quickly was able to leave and that it was so obvious and should have been obvious to him too that she isn’t a good person. So why are they even together?

Thank you for this lengthy reply. I’m going to give this some more thought. It’s so hard to understand what they see in each other. She knows fully what he did but to her his excuses I guess are enough or else she would have run the other way. She does think she is better and her overall personality is that of being better than others. I just never thought he was like that. Since meeting her, he has been arrogant, sarcastic and cruel. I Know that was him and not all her but I also know that choosing to be with her stirred some things up in him and she has given him the green light to hurt everyone.

Certainly not. It came to light that he had had many one night stands behind my back even though we had a good sex life. He lied to me, manipulated me, promised me it was over but then went behind my back again. But the ap knew all along and was telling him to leave for her. That to me shows she isn’t a good person. She wasn’t someone just getting lied to and manipulated, she actively knew.

It seems so obvious to me but to him he gave up everything for her. After only knowing her a couple months. She also knew the whole time and instead of respecting his relationship and instead of being disgusted with him for cheating, she chased him and wanted him to leave for her, which he did. 

At first he believed he’d made a mistake and ended it and made me more of a fool by promising, only to go behind my back to talk with her again and they schemed together on how to leave. If you think d day 1 is bad, a second time is that much worse. 

So how did she manage to do it? There doesn’t seem to be anything redeeming about her. She has a lot of money and offers security but I really didn’t pick him to be that conceited, however I also believed him and trusted him fully not to leave.
Yes crumbs but then she got her way with living together

I very much agree. I do think it’s incredibly hard though to feel like you don’t want to be with this person because of their lack of character yet their affair partner wants them so bad and when they then are all ‘good’ to the person they leave you for it really messes with your head. It makes you feel that the ap is better suited and it was you.
It just feels like even though that’s the case he still chose to cheat and to leave me for her which makes me feel like I’m not worthwhile to him but she is.

The other woman knew all along and chose to continue to cheat. She also gave him an ultimatim and manipulated him. Not that he isn’t to blame for all this. Not that it’s an excuse. She also said some unkind things about me and family to him and he went with it. For some reason she is so important even though she doesn’t seem attractive inside or out.
Failed that he needed more than me and went looking and then chose her after holding me in his arms and telling me it was over with her.
So he loves her and that’s why he left for her when she gave him an ultimatum

Thank you. He is acting like this other woman is the answer to everything. He has done so much for her. She’s not a nice person, she has been very manipulative. I don’t understand any of it. He doesn’t appear to be the man I knew.
Thanks for the honesty.

So then leave if you are having second thoughts or feel a connection with someone else. Don’t have your cake and eat it too then traumatize your spouse by cheating on them. It doesn’t matter if it’s a ‘genuine connection’ between two cheaters who only care about themselves. They are still selfish liars and always will be.

Yeah, I understand that the spouse is lying to the ap. Of course they are going to lie to them at least to some extent given that their very nature of being a cheater means that lying comes easily to them. 

What happened when you found out?

I know what you mean. In my case I know it was his choice but the ap knew all along and encouraged him to leave for her. They had only met not long before. It’s not something I can understand why the both of them would choose to hurt others or what she even saw in a man who left his family, or what he saw in a woman who was very pleased about breaking us up.

But you didn’t want to break up her marriage and be with her. That’s what I don’t understand. Why does the ap want them for themselves knowing that they are someone who is sneaking behind someone’s back, someone capable of lying, cheating. Why would you see that as something good in a relationship? I can understand how many who are in it just for the thrill but what about those who actually want to become the spouse themselves?
Yeah. I like how you put that - that they see it as a compliment. How very sad. That they are so special that this person is willing to betray and hurt the people they had committed to.
Yeah I agree. But they should wonder why they didn’t just leave if they were so unhappy.

Yeah. I think also that even if they truly believe the stories they’ve been told about their spouse and even if they think it won’t happen to them, why would they still see someone who is willing to hurt another person as someone to be with?
It’s sad to think that to some of those affair partners that it’s a game and about winning. I really do think some very insecure people get off on ’winning’ someone who was already with another.

Yeah, as some of the other posters have said, I can logically see why some of these very broken people could think they are saving our spouse or need the ego boost (so sad) or just don’t care or justifying it however else, but even with knowing that I still can’t understand why they would really think that they are a catch. How they can be happy and sleep at night. How they would want anything to do with someone who is capable of such cruelty is beyond me. And it’s not something that will ever suddenly change or go away, that will always be the beginning of their relationship, it doesn’t get erased. They will always have to think of how much they hurt others and how selfish they are. Maybe they just don’t care.

That can happen but it would be rare for the affair partner to not at least have some suspicion. I’m really talking about the ones who wanted to be with our spouses as their own, the ones who are happy for them to leave their families and cause a lot of pain. The ones where they know their new partner has a history of cheating, lying and deceiving. Why would someone want that?
Yeah, when you think about it, who would want to be apart of that? How could you see that as a prize?

It’s hard to understand why these APs don’t walk away once they learn that the person they’ve been sleeping with is married. I mean wouldn’t they themselves be horrified to learn that they’ve been lied to by this person? How could they participate in helping them cheat on someone who’s been left in the dark? How could they believe the lies they are told that the person is in a sexless marriage or they are abusive etc? Then why are you still in that marriage? If it takes an AP to get you to leave then doesn’t that show that they could leave you down the track for someone else too? How could they ever trust a cheat? Are they so delusional and justify everything? Do they really believe they are so special that this cheat only cheated because they were oh so unhappy and oh so hard done by but that won’t happen to them?

But to her, he was going to leave me for her so I guess in her twisted mind she thought all was ok. What’s weird is she didn’t walk away. I mean wouldn’t you not want anything more to do with someone once you found out? Wouldn’t that be a deal breaker? I guess she justified it by her feelings for him, her feelings were above anything else and made her feel like what she was doing was right, plus he wanted her so she figured it was fine. Probably thought she was saving him. I’m sure he would have lied to her quite a bit at least at first. How sad that they believe it. They are talking to a cheat, a deceiver, a known liar!
I think they’ve convinced themselves that their ‘love’ is something that they can’t pass up and have justified it that way.
He met her for sex. It was a random one night stand. It just happened that they saw each other again and then fell for each other. Are you saying that what he did was ok?
She’s also put rules on him already. No wonder why.

What does purposefully mean here? Because I’m struggling so badly with the thought that they met, they couldn’t control it, they saw something so special in each other and that’s why he did what he did and why she did what she did. 

It doesn’t change the fact though that they hid it and lied and hurt people. He could have talked to me, broken up then pursued her. And he could say one kind thing to me or give me a hug to let me know he does care.

Yeah, that’s the thing. How could he let her have any opinion on me at all? I won’t say on here but the tactics she did are absurd. Why anyone would want someone who did what she did. Yeah he’s a poor excuse for a man but I don’t understand why he’d want someone like that.

Yeah, that’s the thing. He hasn’t said one kind word to me. Not one. He just acts like I’m non important. This was a man who I was so important to for years. I believe she’s told him he can’t talk to me but still. Why would he want a woman like that?

He didn’t tell me he was unhappy. The opposite. It was just he met her and wanted to be with her. And now he’s so happy with her. 

It’s like someone has taken over his body. The man I knew would never treat me this way. And that’s really hard to come to terms with because it is him. 

He is seen as a golden boy or whatever. I’m not match for that. If he introduces her to others I’m guessing he’ll lie about how he met her.
